ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Visit name
Notes: e.g., Baseline, 6-Month Follow Up, Year 2, Daily

ElementDescription: Indicates from which form information was derived
Study specific identifier of medication
Name of medication
Medication class; e.g., Antipsychotics
Indication: reason for prescription or medication use
Notes: 1 = Sleep problems; 2 = Restlessness; 3 = Agitation; 4 = Elevated mood; 5 = Depression; 6 = Anxiety; 7 = Psychotic symptoms; 8 = Other; -900 = Missing; -300 = N/A

ElementDescription: If medication indication is other, raters can specify the indication here
Dosage/quantity of medication
Medication onset date
Medication offset date - NOT the last day prescribed but the first day NOT prescribed
Indicates whether medication is still ongoing at point of assessment
Number of days from the participant's informed consent date to the onset date of the medication course
Notes: Day of consent counts as 1; -900 = Missing; -300 = N/A

ElementDescription: Number of days from the participant's informed consent date to the offset date of the medication course
Notes: Day of consent counts as 1; -900 = Missing; -300 = N/A

ElementDescription: Number of days during which the participant used medication
Medication use frequency
Notes: 1 = Regular daily use; 2 = Intermittent use (includes PRN, as needed, or other non-daily use, and Depot, or long-acting injectables); -900 = Missing; -300 = N/A

ElementDescription: Frequency per month of medication use - number of doses taken per month on average
Level of participant complicance for medication intake; this percentage is an estimate
Notes: 0 = 0% never took med; 100 = 100% took exactly as prescribed; -900 = Missing; -300 = N/A
